title: ModuleCat sheaves and sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaf
statement: Let Λ : Type (u+1) be a commutative ring and X : Scheme.{u} [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let R be the underlying ring sheaf of the sheafification of the constant CommRingCat-valued presheaf with value Λ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. There exists an equivalence from Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u+1} Λ) [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] to SheafOfModules.{u+1} R [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], together with a natural isomorphism from its composite with SheafOfModules.toSheaf R to sheafCompose of the ModuleCat-to-AddCommGrpCat forgetful functor [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Thus the same additive sheaf is retained; no injectivity or torsion assumption is imposed.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Section 18.42, opening paragraph; underlying-abelian convention in Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 21.12.4 (03FD). Encoding construction written by the worker from these definitions.

proof.text: Encode ModuleCat-valued presheaves as modules over the constant RingCat presheaf by retaining each module and restriction map. The componentwise inverse on morphisms proves this encoding fully faithful; composing with the fully faithful sheaf inclusion yields moduleEmbedding. Define scalarUnit by forgetting the CommRingCat sheafification unit. The underlying-set sheafification instances make it locally injective and locally surjective. Apply the Mathlib module-sheafification functor along scalarUnit to moduleEmbedding to obtain moduleExtension.

The unit of the module-sheafification adjunction at moduleEmbedding(F) underlies the ordinary abelian-presheaf sheafification unit. Since F is a sheaf, its underlying additive presheaf is a sheaf and this unit is invertible. The forgetful functor to additive presheaves reflects isomorphisms, so the module unit is invertible too. Whiskering gives moduleEmbeddingUnitIso. Fullness and faithfulness of moduleExtension follow by cancellation against restriction of scalars, using the fully faithful moduleEmbedding and the faithful right adjoint. These are Functor.Faithful.of_comp_iso and Functor.Full.of_comp_faithful_iso.

For an R-module sheaf M, restrict its scalars along scalarUnit. The resulting constant-ring module presheaf encodes a ModuleCat-valued presheaf F, whose underlying additive presheaf is definitionally M.val.presheaf. Reflection of the sheaf property by ModuleCat-to-AddCommGrpCat therefore gives moduleRestrictionObj(M). Its image under moduleEmbedding is definitionally the restricted module presheaf. The invertible counit of Mathlib module sheafification consequently gives moduleExtension(moduleRestrictionObj(M)) isomorphic to M, proving essential surjectivity. Use Functor.asEquivalence for the resulting fully faithful essentially surjective functor. The ordinary additive-sheafification counit, evaluated at the underlying additive sheaf of F, defines moduleExtensionForgetIso; counit naturality proves its naturality. This is the required compatibility, with the original universes and without extra hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Constant-coefficient encoding argument, implemented using the module-sheafification adjunction of Mathlib.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Presheaf.Sheafification (Stacks Tag 03CY), its invertible counit, and its unit on an already sheaf-valued object; additive compatibility uses the ordinary sheafification counit.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleSheaf_constantRing_equivalence
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (X : Scheme.{u})
    : let R : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology RingCat.{u + 1} := (sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        ((constantSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj (CommRingCat.of Λ))
    ∃ (e : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ≌
      SheafOfModules.{u + 1} R),
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ SheafOfModules.toSheaf R ≅
        sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology
          (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
